flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4173/ then Add Colombia Huila to the bag, open the bag and go to checkout.
Fill in name Ada Lovelace, email ada@example.com, street 12 Rua Augusta, city Lisbon, and place the order.
Check that the confirmation page says the order is in and that €17.90 was charged. That is the bag total (€13.00 for the coffee plus €4.90 shipping); the confirmation page only shows the total. Any other charged amount means the shop charged the wrong total.

Do each step once, the way it is described. If a click or a key press does something other than what the step expects, the check fails: don't retry it, and don't reach the goal another way (other buttons, links, keyboard shortcuts, typing the URL). Waiting for a slow page to load is fine.
